Definition: a little or few (often adverbial or compar.)
BiblicalUsage: 1) littleness, few, a little, fewness; 1a) little, small, littleness, fewness, too little, yet a little; 1b) like a little, within a little, almost, just, hardly, shortly, little worth
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
